summary: Aveanna Healthcare Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K on June 2, 2026, announcing the completion of its acquisition of Family First Holding, LLC (Family First Homecare) via its wholly-owned subsidiary Pediatric Services of America, LLC. The cash purchase price was $175.5 million, subject to customary working capital adjustments, and was funded with cash on hand. The deal, originally disclosed in a March 12, 2026 8-K, expands Aveanna's pediatric home care footprint across seven states. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The press release updates FY2026 guidance to include the acquired operations. Watch for integration updates and future earnings impact.
